18.t: Working with data: hormones in the cycle
q: On which day does LH peak?
Describe what happens to oestrogen from day 0 to day 12.
It rises from about 10 to 70 units.
Explain the link between the LH peak and ovulation.
The surge of LH triggers the release of an egg from the ovary (ovulation) around day 14.
Progesterone falls after day 21. Explain what this causes, and what would happen if pregnancy had begun.
Falling progesterone means the uterus lining breaks down: menstruation starts. In pregnancy progesterone stays high, so the lining is kept.
